payload.content: A construction WordPress website for Casareno connecting renovation, new-build and turn-key services with completed projects and a clear route towards a personal consultation.
payload.description_1: Homeowners may start with anything from a bathroom or floor to a complete renovation or new-build project. The site therefore had to connect inspiration, individual services and larger project routes without making visitors understand the full construction process before finding what fits their plans.
payload.description_2: I structured the experience around recognisable construction routes, supported by project examples and a five-step working process. Individual services remain easy to find, while larger renovation, new-build and turn-key journeys provide deeper context before the consultation action. The same hierarchy remains understandable on smaller screens.
